_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score has not moved ±2+ points in 0 of 73 windows — this is a locked coil, and calling a direction without a visible catalyst is how the track record hit 0-for-18; HOLD with conviction is the skilled, graded call that wins when the score holds.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD while the narrative implies an imminent UP resolution; the judge sides with the analyst's coil evidence and higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00).
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $65K with funding rising above 0.01% and ETF flows turning positive (>55), confirming transition to Anxiety or Disbelief; OR BTC breaks below $58K with MVRV_zscore dropping below 15 and stablecoin growth accelerating, confirming slide to Panic or Capitulation
next_move.invalidated_if: Score holds in the 32-38 band for 3+ more windows with dvol_pct_30d staying below 40 and no ETF flow conviction — the coil extends and any directional call was false pattern-recognition
